About

One of two new condominium buildings at the Club at Schaefer Landing. The south building is a 15-story building containing 75 units.

Uniquely spacious layouts are thoughtfully designed and appointed for truly comfortable living on a grand scale. Choose from fabulous studio, one, two, or three bedroom homes with lustrous hardwood floors and expansive windows. Many have private balconies or terraces with breathtaking river and city views. Exceptional finishes and distinctive accents create an ambience of quality, style, and splendor.
